endorsements.name: Zoltan Panczel
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-31870
endorsements.description: IBM Db2 for i 7.2, 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5 supplies user defined table function is vulnerable to user enumeration by a local authenticated attacker, without having authority to the related *USRPRF objects.  This can be used by a malicious actor to gather information about users that can be targeted in further attacks.  IBM X-Force ID:  287174.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.3)

endorsements.label: CVE-2024-38330
